savings.reason: EO13350 section 1 preserves prior actions, pending proceedings, actions based on prior acts, matured rights/duties and incurred penalties. Those accrued matters may concern construction already undertaken; this proposal asserts no particular project completion. Section 1's continued blocking rule expressly concerns EO12722/12724 property, not an independent prospective construction command in EO12734.

research_rationale: Withdraw the complete exact-date claim. Separate the construction invocation from immediate-effectiveness, congressional-transmission and publication commands. EO13350 expressly revokes prospective construction authority effective July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT. That act does not establish the original notice commands first ceased in 2004. The printed November 19, 1990 Federal Register representation supplies publication evidence and a latest-completion bound, while exact first completion and congressional transmittal remain unproved. Savings retain accrued actions and duties rather than authorizing a new construction program.
unresolved_material_gaps: Congressional-transmission actual completion/first-end date is unheld. The Federal Register issue date November 19, 1990 establishes a completion bound, not independently the actual first publication/completion timing for an exact-date schema.
The prior whole scope incorrectly assigned later 2004 revocation as the first end of notice commands. Distinct scopes are now retained without guessed exact dates.
